title: Weaver
description: An origin that utilizes its dash to travel through walls and to heal from battles.
body:
# 🕸️ Weaver
### (Impact 2)
_Tangled in webs that transcend the laws of reality, the Weavers can move gracefully around the world._

### Powerlist

<details>
<summary>👁️ Eight-Eyed</summary>

You have night vision when not exposed to the sun.

</details>

<details>
<summary>☁️ Spinneret</summary>

At the cost of hunger and when on the ground, you're capable of dashing. You're invisible and able to phase through walls during the duration, Being attacked will put this on a three second cooldown.

- _You can use this with an elytra however it exhausts you more._

- _When attacking somebody a second after dashing, you can inflict Widow's Mark onto your opponent._

</details>

<details>
<summary>❤️ Itsy Bitsy</summary>

You have two less hearts and can avoid fall damage by crouching.

- _You cannot naturally regenerate._

</details>

<details>
<summary>🕸️ Crawling</summary>

For a limited time you're capable of climbing walls. While climbing, jumping will push you off the wall.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🕷️ Arthropod</summary>

You take more damage from the Bane of Arthropod enchant.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🥴 Continual Hunt</summary>

You passively exhaust, this is much faster when sprinting.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🩸 Widow's Mark</summary>

Entities under this effect cannot see or heal and continually exhaust, you are fed during the duration of this effect.

</details>

### Additional
Icon by me, inspired by Vortex Agent from Somnia.
